title: Create your first business
subtitle: Follow these steps to set up your business

step1.title: Basic information
step1.description: Fill in the basic information for your business
step1.name: Business name *
step1.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe your business (optional). Use **text** for bold and Enter for line breaks.

step2.title: Location
step2.description: Fill in the location and address of your business

step3.title: Contact
step3.whatsappPlaceholderPhone: The phone number will be used
step3.whatsappHintWithCountry: The country code for {{country}} will be added automatically if you do not include it
step3.whatsappHintNoCountry: Enter the number with country code (e.g.: +54 11 1234-5678) or just the local number

step4.title: Payment methods
step4.description: Set up payment currencies for your business
step4.additionalCurrenciesHint: Click the currencies you want to accept in addition to the default currency

step5.title: Images
step5.description: Add your business logo and cover photo
step5.logoHint: Recommended: square image of at least 400×400 px (PNG or JPG).
step5.uploadHint: Drag an image or click to select

step6.title: Template and colors
step6.description: Choose your menu design and brand colors. Then you will continue with menu creation.
step6.templateHelp: Select a template. You can change it later and adjust your brand colors.
step6.templateHint: This template will be applied to all menus of this business
step6.brandColorsHelp: Customize your business primary colors. These colors apply to buttons, titles, and highlighted elements.

proMobile.name: Modern Food
proMobile.desc: Modern design with side tabs and product photos

beachBar.name: Beach Life
beachBar.desc: Beach bar with configurable background and horizontal cards

solNoche.name: Sol & Noche
solNoche.desc: Light/dark mode, featured items, and day/night covers

nightClub.name: Neon Club
nightClub.desc: Dark theme with side tabs, no photos

proLock.title: Pro template
proLock.body: The {{name}} template is available only for Pro or Business users.
proLock.hint: You can continue with a free template (you can change it later) or view subscription plans. This template is for Pro users only.
